title: Automobile Loan Credit File Review Checklist
notice: Draft workflow checklist transcribed from the supplied requirements. Confirm applicability, mandatory status, thresholds and wording against current approved bank policy and applicable regulation before operational use. A checked item means reviewed by a human; it does not mean passed or approved.

sections.title: Borrower KYC and identity
items: KYC tab is completed and information matches attached documents
Loan application date and account number
Customer name, gender, marital status and nationality
Date of birth (AD/BS) and age
Permanent and current address, including province, district, municipality/VDC, ward, street and house number
Phone and contact details, including alternate mobile and email
Three-generation details: father, mother, spouse (if married), father-in-law and grandfather
Citizenship number, issue date (AD/BS) and issuing district
National ID number and issue date, if applicable
Driving licence number and issue date, if applicable
Passport number, issue date and expiry date, if applicable
PAN number, issue date and issuing tax office, if applicable
PEP declaration and supporting verification

sections.title: Facility and loan details
items: Facility type and purpose
Proposed loan amount and intended loan amount
Loan tenure and EMI frequency
Interest rate and EMI amount
Drawdown details
Existing borrower exposure and other facilities with the Bank
Preferred branch and route, where applicable

sections.title: Vehicle and quotation details
items: Vehicle type, brand, model and year of production
Dealer name, phone number and email address
Vehicle quotation amount
Proposed down-payment amount
Multiple vehicles, if applicable, are separately recorded

sections.title: Security and collateral details
items: Vehicle security details match the LOS Security Details tab and supporting documents
Land and building collateral details, if applicable
Property details match attached ownership and supporting documents
Security documents and collateral description are consistent

sections.title: Valuation report review
items: Valuation date and property details
Area valued
Fair Market Value (FMV) and Distress Value (DV)
Frontage, road details and four boundaries
Right of Way (ROW)
Check references to river, high-tension line, army barracks and no-man's-land
Market rate and government rate

sections.title: Guarantor details
items: Guarantor name, date of birth and age
Relationship with borrower
Permanent and current address
Citizenship and contact information
Three-generation information
Occupation/profession and income information
PEP declaration
Additional guarantors recorded where required

sections.title: Group exposure
items: Group details
Group limit
Group outstanding

sections.title: CIC report review
items: Name, date of birth and citizenship number
Citizenship issue date, father's name and grandfather's name
CIR number and report date
Probability of Default (PD)
Blacklisting history and active blacklisting details
Total active loan accounts and number of institutions
Maximum and minimum days overdue in the last 24 months, with reported month
Total EMI, total facilities and total sanctioned amount
Total outstanding balance and total amount overdue
Overdue ageing buckets and recent overdue amount/date

sections.title: Repayment capacity
items: Industry average considered
Declared income reviewed
Tax statement reviewed
Bank statement reviewed
Agreement documents and certificates reviewed
Pay slips or other applicable income evidence reviewed

sections.title: Control and compliance checks
items: Borrower age eligibility checked against approved policy
Borrower age at loan maturity checked against approved policy
Vehicle age checked against approved policy
Loan tenure compared with vehicle age as required by the supplied checklist
Guarantor availability confirmed
Guarantor age and age at maturity checked against approved policy
Proposed loan amount compared with quotation amount against approved policy
Customer PEP status checked
Driving licence validity checked, where applicable
Customer experience checked against approved policy
Other loan facilities with the Bank checked

sections.title: Additional documents
items: RORC
ICRR
Experience document
RSVR
CVSR

sections.title: Required document inventory
items: Citizenship document: presence, OCR/extraction and verification
National ID: conditional applicability, OCR/extraction and verification
Driving licence: applicability, OCR/extraction and verification
Vehicle quotation: presence, OCR/extraction and verification
Income document: applicability, OCR/extraction and verification
Bank statement: conditional applicability, OCR/extraction and verification
Business registration: conditional applicability, OCR/extraction and verification
Guarantor citizenship: presence, OCR/extraction and verification

sections.title: CIC acceptance criteria from supplied checklist
items: PD threshold checked against current approved criteria
Active overdue status checked
Overdue in the last six instalments checked
Active blacklisting records checked
Blacklisting history checked
Active loan accounts checked for pass category
Guaranteed loan accounts checked for pass category

sections.title: Security document preparation and verification
items: Information extracted from attached documents using approved OCR, where available
Extracted information entered into the prescribed format for non-standard documents
Borrower and guarantor details verified
Facility details verified
Security details verified
All required documents uploaded as per prescribed checklist
Required security documents properly executed
Approval log checked against standard
Unit and group limits extracted and checked
Variations escalated or communicated to the branch
Final decision recorded by an authorized human reviewer
